text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break. When I asked Sirius Symboli
what she did on her time off—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it from a light aircraft.
That fleeting moment when the shining stars ruled the world."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I feel absolutely magnificent. Everything is beneath me.
The world, everything...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll take you along with me one of these days. If you're a good boy, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Traveling through the skies
seems to have thoroughly refreshed them!
